title: Antietam Pool

services.name: Swim Team
services.desc: Antietam Pool will again be offering Group, Private, and Parent/Tot lessons in 2026. Group Lessons - Will begin the week of June 15. Lessons run by the week and include 4 lessons (one each on Monday - Thursday). If there is bad weather, the make-up will be on Friday at the same time. Lessons are either at 10AM or 6PM (you must pick one time slot for the week). Cost per week is $55 per child of members; $65 per child of non-members. Sign-ups will begin on June 1st in the pool office. Payment is due at the time of sign-up to reserve your child’s spot. We accept cash, check, credit, or debit. A 3% fee will be added on to all payments made by card. We must have 4 children to run a class.

services.name: Rec Rental
services.desc: AVRCC rents out the recreation center located in the 900 block of Byram Street for events such as birthday parties, wedding receptions, first Holy communion parties, baptisms, and graduation parties. The Rec Center is a free standing one-floor brick building equipped with a kitchen, bathrooms and large open gathering area. We offer a full kitchen, and rectangular tables and chairs to seat 100. The rec center is heated, but does not have air conditioning or WiFi. Current pool members will receive a once a year discount on Saturday or Sunday rentals.
